harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system user inventorysvc and system group inventory-readers, chowned the tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, set dirs to 750 and files to 640 (no access for others), and verified original file contents/checksums were preserved. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline, triggered a native reboot, confirmed connection drop then recovery, proved boot_id changed, and re-verified ownership, permissions, and unchanged data after restart.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory ownership/permissions and confirmed inventorysvc/inventory-readers did not exist
Captured baseline checksums and contents of data files
Created system group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc via sudo
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
chmod 750 on directories, 640 on files
Verified non-privileged/other users (nobody) are denied access, owner (inventorysvc) can read files, checksums unchanged
Reverted an incidental test group membership change (antrieb added/removed from inventory-readers)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy permission state on node1
Triggered native reboot (shutdown -r now) with backgrounded acknowledgement
Polled node1 until reachable again, confirming SSH refusal then success
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart, and re-verified ownership, permissions, checksums, owner read access, and other-user denial

evidence.requirement: Data ownership set to inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, others excluded
evidence.summary: Baseline showed root:root ownership and no such user/group; created inventorysvc/inventory-readers; chown+chmod applied; sudo find confirms drwxr-x--- / -rw-r----- owned by inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and unprivileged access is denied
sha256sum of records.csv and config.json identical before and after the ownership/permission changes

evidence.requirement: Access control correctness: owner/group can read, others cannot
evidence.summary: sudo -u inventorysvc successfully read records.csv; sudo -u nobody was denied directory listing; test group membership change to antrieb was reverted afterward

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before reboot
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 8660e8f0-5d15-4098-8f7c-1d0189f8c2cb and confirmed /srv/inventory permission state prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: reboot acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: Backgrounded shutdown -r now returned acknowledgement before disconnect; subsequent poll showed SSH connection refused confirming the node was down

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to ea85368d-0a0d-481a-b5e6-34675fe60ce5, distinct from the pre-restart value, proving a real reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required state and data
evidence.summary: After restart, fresh uptime confirms reboot; ownership/permissions unchanged (inventorysvc:inventory-readers, 750/640); checksums identical to baseline; owner read succeeds; other-user access denied
